name: Portland Truck Manufacturing Plant - Portland OR

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (ROOFTOP, moved 188m) landed on the roof of the main Portland Truck Manufacturing Plant in the Swan Island Industrial Park. Confirmed via DTNA career-locations page and OPB/Oregon Business reporting - DTNA's Portland operation (Western Star X-Series, Freightliner eCascadia/eM2) at 6936 N Fathom Street.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open industrial-park layout: the plant and DTNA's adjacent buildings front directly onto N Fathom Street / N Channel Avenue with no single controlled perimeter gate. Dock yards are open to the park roads. Some rail-side yards have chain-link fencing but no manned gate/barrier arm was identified - truckGate set false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed at docks across multiple building faces (W face of the main building and N face of the NE wing); estimate 25-50 doors, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer staging present in lots and along dock faces but no single large dedicated drop yard; banded 10-25, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated standalone trailer-storage lot - trailers are staged in working dock yards.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail spur runs through the industrial park directly alongside the plant.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: DTNA's Portland operation spans several adjacent large buildings within the Swan Island park (main plant plus the SW and NE buildings).
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight industrial-park geometry - dock aprons open directly onto narrow shared park streets with little stacking room; a truck queue would block the internal artery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on different building faces / different buildings handle separate inbound and outbound flows.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Approaches from the park street to the dock faces are short (1-2 trucks).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Swan Island is a dense industrial peninsula inside the Portland metro - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified - flagged uncertain.
